title: Hot Cocoa Mix

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes in the target week. The baseline already reflects recent trends, including the dip after Father's Day and the low sales in early July. Past promotions show weak, noise-adjusted lift (x1.0) and post-promotion pullback (x0.85), but none apply here. The classical uplift model correctly suggests no adjustment. The baseline’s uncertainty (83% noise) supports keeping the median at 1.0 with default spreads.

It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-83% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
